text:
Oliver (CS): Heads up — BrightCart hitting bursts of 429s on dedicated pool `dc-brightcart` since ~08:30 UTC. Customer reports repeated throttling and UI errors. Metrics show scale up/down churn every ~2 minutes and some pods terminating mid-spike. Support ticket #SUP-4821 opened.

Maya (SRE): Can you paste the prom queries/time ranges? Any deploys this morning? Which autoscaler policy?

Oliver (CS): No deploys this morning. Link to dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/dc-brightcart (private). 429 spikes line up with pod term events in the node group.

Jason (SRE): Quick checks I ran — looks like very short-lived drops in GPU/CPU util then immediate scale-down. Prom queries I used: 
```
rate(redwood_requests_total{pool="dc-brightcart",status="429"}[5m])
max_over_time(redwood_gpu_utilization{pool="dc-brightcart"}[5m])
sum(rate(redwood_request_queue_length{pool="dc-brightcart"}[30s]))
```
Autoscaler config currently: `cooldown_seconds: 60`, `min_replicas: 1`, `target_concurrency: 80`.

Sasha (eng-runtime): This smells like hysteresis/cold-KV cache issue + noisy-batching. If a batch causes a cache miss, per-request latency jumps, some callers time out/rate-limit, util dips as requests queue, autoscaler sees the dip and scales down, then warmup and back-and-forth. With cooldown=60s that's too aggressive for our workload pattern.

Maya (SRE): Repro steps we can run? We should also have a quick mitigation: bump `min_replicas` to 2 and increase cooldown to 180s while we investigate.

Jason (SRE): Patching command I used (applied to dc-brightcart as emergency):
```
# patch pool to reduce oscillation
redwoodctl pools update dc-brightcart --min-replicas 2 --cooldown 180
```
Also disabled scale-to-zero for that pool: `--scale-to-zero=false`. deploy-bot applied change at 08:45 UTC.

Jason (SRE): Repro load snippet if you want to simulate the pattern:
```
# quick spike test with wrk (lua payload to hit generation endpoint)
wrk -t4 -c200 -d2m http://dc-brightcart.redwood/api/generate -s scripts/payload.lua

# or parallel curl farm
seq 1 1000 | xargs -n1 -P50 -I% curl -s -X POST http://dc-brightcart.redwood/api/generate -d @payload.json -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
Use `X-Trace: true` header to capture request_id for traces.

Sasha (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation is good. Longer term: move autoscaler metric from instantaneous concurrency to a smoothed rate/p95-latency window (1m smoothing) and add explicit hysteresis: require sustained signal for 90s before scale down. Also add a prefix-warmup job to prewarm KV cache on scale events. I can open a PR to change the autoscaler scoring.

Maya (SRE): Can we also add a warmup step on scale-up (prewarm threads)? There is `redwoodctl cache prewarm` IIRC.

Sasha (eng-runtime): Yup — run `redwoodctl cache prewarm --pool dc-brightcart --model rwd-3b` as part of scale-up hook. I'll prototype this in staging.

Oliver (CS): I've told BrightCart we applied a mitigation and are monitoring. They've seen 429s drop after the change; they're waiting for a full confirmation.

Jason (SRE): After min_replicas=2 + cooldown=180 we saw 429s drop close to 0 in the last 20m, queue length normalized. p95 latency still has jitter (~95th ~300–450ms) but no user-facing throttles.

Maya (SRE): Alerts/monitors I adjusted: raised the `scale-flap` alert window to 3m, added p95-latency > 800ms alert for 5m. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/dc-brightcart. Logs: `redwoodctl logs --pool dc-brightcart --since 30m --filter "status:429"` for triage.

Jason (SRE): Next steps (short-term):
- Keep min_replicas=2 and cooldown=180 for 6–12h while we observe.
- Run controlled spike test using wrk to validate.
- Collect traces for ~10 sample request_ids and attach to ticket.

Sasha (eng-runtime): Long-term plan (proposal):
- Change autoscaler scoring to use smoothed metrics (1m window) and p95-latency as a scale signal.
- Add scale-up warmers (prewarm KV) and make scale-down require 90s sustained low usage.
- Add canary rollout of changes on `dc-staging` then `dc-prod` pool.
PR opened: https://git.redwood/repl/eng-runtime/pull/789 (internal).

Maya (SRE): Owner for follow-up/postmortem? Tagging eng-sre, eng-runtime, cs.

Jason (SRE): I'll own the follow-up and draft a blameless postmortem. Will include repro steps, prom queries, and the final config change dates.

deploy-bot: Emergency patch applied to pool `dc-brightcart`.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026 created and linked to SUP-4821.

Oliver (CS): Customer updated: "Thanks, seeing much fewer errors now — appreciated the fast response :thumbsup:" Will close the loop once they run full CI.

Maya (SRE): Good job everyone. After 12h if stable we'll revert min_replicas back to normal and instead deploy the smoother autoscaler.

Jason (SRE): I'll post the postmortem draft here when ready and link to ticket + PR.

Sasha (eng-runtime): Adding a note: also consider applying a tiny circuit-breaker on the routing layer to avoid hard 429s during flaps (graceful queueing instead).

Oliver (CS): Thanks all. Will update SUP-4821.
